mistake_reason: At step 23, the WebSurfer agent unilaterally finalized the investigation and declared the total answer (2), instructing the team to stop further checks. This exceeds WebSurfer’s defined role as a browsing/execution agent and assumes supervisory authority to conclude the task. By prematurely halting verification (e.g., not checking August 22 and remaining days), this role violation directly caused the wrong final answer. This matches FM-1.2: Disobey Role Specification.
